user.title: Vevor Heater (AA66)
user.description: Pick your heater from the list (heaters currently in range), or type its MAC. If it isn't listed, disable the old Diesel Heater integration and close the Vevor app: the heater stops advertising while something is connected.

init.title: Cabin thermostat
init.description: Pick your cabin sensor to create a thermostat that runs the heater in Level mode. Temperatures are in your Home Assistant unit.
